notes: All 130 rows are EXACT values transcribed from the Opus 5.5 launch page's inline chart-module SVG aria-labels (format "Model · effort: score% $cost" or, for the Elo-scored GDPval-AA v2.1 chart, "Model · effort: elo $cost"), not pixel digitization of a raster image. This is the same evidence class used for the Fable 5.1 launch capture (see performance/anthropic-fable-mythos-5-1-2026-09.json) and GPT-6 Astra launch capture — source_type vendor_table, evidence_grade C, NOT source_type digitized_chart. No PNG chart assets were downloaded for this document because none exist on this launch post: all six data figures render as same-page SVG with per-point aria-labels, and the page's other images (hero/prefooter 'arc' graphics) are decorative, not data charts. digitized/assets/ is therefore NOT populated by this document; scripts/digitize_chart.py (density-peak marker centroid extraction) was not invoked because there was no raster chart to invoke it on. Six same-model effort x cost x quality curves: Terminal-Bench 4.0, FrontierCode v1.1 (main set — distinct from the existing frontiercode-1-1-extended metric_id), CursorBench 4.0 (distinct from existing cursorbench-3-2-0), GDPval-AA v2.1 (distinct from existing gdpval-aa-v2, which was itself a digitized_chart reading of the v2 Opus 5 launch figure), AutomationBench (matches the existing automationbench metric_id/definition), and WANDR (new metric, no prior entry). Series coverage is NOT uniform across charts — this mirrors what the launch page itself shows, not an extraction gap: CursorBench 4.0 omits GPT-6 Astra; AutomationBench omits Fable 5.1; WANDR omits both GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol. claude-opus-5-5 is NOT YET in models.json as of this document's commit (another workstream owns the model registry entry, pricing, capabilities, and the launch-post HEADLINE benchmark table at performance/anthropic-opus-5-5-launch-2026-09.json) — scripts/validate_data_pack.py is expected to fail model-id resolution for claude-opus-5-5 until that entry lands; every other model id here (claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5, gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-sol) already resolves. The page's Alignment section is qualitative prose only ('scored better than any recent Claude model on nearly every measure of misaligned behavior') with NO accompanying chart or bar labels giving numeric values, unlike the Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 launch posts which had a printed misaligned-behavior bar chart — so no misaligned-behavior rows are recorded here; see missing[]. The BenchmarkGrid headline table and the per-1M-token pricing table on this page are explicitly out of scope for this document (owned by the separate models.json/pricing/capabilities/headline-benchmark integration pass per the task brief) and are not transcribed here even though they were visible during retrieval.
